clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952 and the purchase of the orchard, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, Walter out in the trees from dark to dark with distance growing between them, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June kept to her bed for weeks that winter, rows between Walter and June over money for trees, and by September June joined the church choir and her letters thinned out. No one else's shifts show in these months.

clusters.name: The orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost took the whole crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter drinking heavily most nights, conflict between Walter and Glen over who was to blame, Glen and Marian taking over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worsening that winter, Nora wetting the bed again in the spring, Ida's heart trouble found and told to stop working, and Walter stopped drinking by October and took work pruning other men's trees.

clusters.name: Glen's job loss at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975: Glen out of work most of that year sitting in the truck in the yard for hours, loud fights between Glen and Marian over money at night, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night, Nora stopped eating properly and lost weight that summer, kept to her room and said little to her mother, Walter drinking again after six years off it, and by June Nora was eating again and made the track team.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Sam's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Sam's mother Wilma selling her farm and moving into Nora and Sam's house in January 1990: clashes between Nora and Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals, Sam taking his mother's side and moving toward her while Nora worked late and kept out of the kitchen rows, Owen's tantrums at preschool, Wilma taking over Lily's care, Nora's eczema flaring on both hands, rows between Nora and Sam most nights, Marian driving over twice a week to take Nora's side, Wilma took a flat in town in June 1991, and by August the eczema cleared.
